title: India ERSS 112 - system features
organization: Emergency Response Support System, Government of India
text: ERSS 112 describes a unified emergency response model with state emergency response centres, computer-aided dispatch, GIS and shortest-path analysis for emergency response vehicles. This is system-level context; it does not establish a universal rule for choosing a patient's destination hospital.

title: 911 - Frequently asked questions
text: 911 call handling collects information and helps route emergency response. Procedures and local capabilities vary by jurisdiction. This source is general call-taking context, not a clinical destination protocol.

title: Dispatch prototype safety rule
organization: Accident Response System project protocol (demonstration document)
text: For this prototype, a facility recommendation is decision support only. The ranking engine filters by configured capability and availability and then ranks by configured travel-time weights. An authorized human operator must confirm dispatch. Do not infer patient diagnosis, hospital acceptance, live traffic, or GPS position from video or simulation.

title: Simulation and data provenance rule
organization: Accident Response System project protocol (demonstration document)
text: Coordinates generated by demo mode are simulated and must be labelled SIMULATION. Route ETA based on an illustrative speed or synthetic graph is an estimate, not live traffic. Evidence summaries may report only fields present in the incident record and must distinguish missing information from negative findings.
